name: English - English Conversation Partners Program B1-C1+
description:
An informal class in which lower/ intermediate-level (approximately B1 of the GER) English speakers are placed in small groups with upper-level (approximately C1+ of the GER) speakers to practice English conversation in a fun and friendly environment. The class will meet regularly throughout the semester for larger group activities, but the majority of speaking practice will be done within the small groups, on students' own schedules. 

Regardless of their level, all students are equal partners in the course: More confident speakers should be willing to take on a guiding role, and everyone should be culturally inquisitive, open-minded and keen to talk. We hope that alongside conversational practice and improvement you will find interesting cultural exchange and perhaps new friends in a mixed nationality class.  

This course is offered on a pass/fail basis and is worth 2 ECTS points. To pass the course, students are required to attend class meetings, to participate actively in their group activities (keeping a “conversation diary”), and to contribute to a group assignment (to be specified by the lecturer).
prerequisites: English speaking skills at approximately the B1-C2 level of the GER. PLEASE COMPLETE THE PLACEMENT TEST BEFORE YOU REGISTER!
